newsitem.title: USA: Toronto-Dominion unit hires head junk bond trader.
newsitem.headline: Toronto-Dominion unit hires head junk bond trader.

text.p: Derrick Herndon, a former junk bond trader at BT Securities Corp, has been named managing director and head of high-yield sales and trading at TD Securities (USA) Inc, the U.S. securities arm of Toronto-Dominion Bank said Peter Bethlenfalvy, president and chief operating officer of TD Securities.

TD Securities plans to hire 10 additional individuals over the next several months as part of an ongoing expansion of its U.S. high-yield effort, Bethlenfalvy said. The new hires will be spread evenly between sales and trading, research and originations, he said.
TD Security's current U.S. high-yield department consists of 30 people, he noted.

As head of sales and trading, a newly created position, Herndon will report directly to Bethlenfalvy. He will work along side Mark Grotevant, head of high-yield research, and Gordon Paris, head of high-yield originations and capital markets at TD.
